newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PROUD FATHER BERG LOOKING FOR DOUBLE CELEBRATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PROUD FATHER BERG LOOKING FOR DOUBLE CELEBRATION.

text.p: Defender Henning Berg has flown out for World Cup duty just hours after becoming the proud father of a baby son.
Berg will be hoping for a double celebration following the birth of his son with Norwegian winning their European group three qualifier against Hungary.

The Blackburn Rovers player has shaken off the effects of a virus infection which kept him out of Blackburn's last premier league game at Coventry, but he should be back in the squad for this Saturday's home match against Arsenal.
